name: Clemens Schotte
headline: Dutch software engineer, platform builder, and founder of NavaTron B.V.
bio_short: Clemens Schotte is a Dutch software engineer, platform builder, technology leader, and founder of NavaTron B.V. with 25+ years of experience across Microsoft technologies, .NET, Azure, Business Central, SaaS products, AI-assisted software development, and independent technical projects.
bio_long: Clemens Schotte is a Dutch technology leader, software architect, entrepreneur, and founder of NavaTron B.V. based in The Hague, Netherlands. His background spans software engineering, cloud architecture, product management, program leadership, developer relations, and enterprise software delivery. He spent many years at Microsoft in roles including Application Platform Consultant, Senior Premier Field Engineer, Senior Technical Evangelist, Cloud Consultant / Architect, and Senior Program Manager for Azure Maps. His current focus areas include cloud modernization, AI-enabled automation, enterprise SaaS platforms, route optimization, business process digitization, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central extensibility, and practical software engineering. He writes at clemens.ms about Azure, Azure Maps, .NET/C#, AI agents, Model Context Protocol, semantic search, DevOps, geospatial systems, retro computing, game development, and personal technical projects.
